Shiny render expression for the Mosaic + deck.gl viewer

Source: R/mosaic_gl.R
renderMosaic_gl.Rd

Shiny render expression for the Mosaic + deck.gl viewer

Usage

renderMosaic_gl(expr, env = parent.frame(), quoted = FALSE)

Arguments

expr

An expression that returns a list.

env

The parent environment for the reactive expression. By default, this is the calling environment, the same as when defining an ordinary non-reactive expression. If expr is a quosure and quoted is TRUE, then env is ignored.

quoted

If it is TRUE, then the quote()ed value of expr will be used when expr is evaluated. If expr is a quosure and you would like to use its expression as a value for expr, then you must set quoted to TRUE.

Value

A Shiny render function for use with [mosaic_glOutput()].

Examples

if (interactive() && requireNamespace("shiny", quietly = TRUE) &&
    requireNamespace("arrow", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pts <- data.frame(id = 1:100, x = stats::rnorm(100), y = stats::rnorm(100))
  spec <- mgl_spec(
    data = list(pts = mgl_data(type = "table", df = pts)),
    plot = list(list(mark = "dot", data = list(from = "pts"), x = "x", y = "y")))
  shiny::shinyApp(
    ui = shiny::fluidPage(mosaic_glOutput("viewer")),
    server = function(input, output) {
      output$viewer <- renderMosaic_gl(mosaic_gl(spec))
    })
}
